_comment: VPS dry-run overlay. Copy to config/local/vps.json (gitignored) and layer it between base.json and config/local/secrets.json: --config base.json --config local/vps.json --config local/secrets.json. dry_run stays true here; this file never carries credentials. api_server.listen_ip_address 0.0.0.0 is the address *inside the container*; compose.vps.example.yaml publishes only 127.0.0.1:8080 on the host, so the API is never reachable except via an SSH tunnel or from the host itself.
